claims.claim: Most mainstream cordless tool lines use five lithium-ion cells to produce an 18-volt nominal pack.
claims.episode_span: Most mainstream lines use five lithium-ion cells to produce an 18-volt nominal pack, though marketing often lists the 20-volt peak voltage measured right after charge.
claims.supporting_quote: 18V/20V class, five cells: drills, drivers, circular saws, the core of most contractor kits

claims.claim: Cordless tool packs were historically built from 18650 cells measuring 18 millimeters across and 65 millimeters long.
claims.episode_span: Commodity lithium-ion cells trade in the low tens of dollars per kilowatt-hour in bulk, so a typical 2–3 amp-hour pack contains roughly a few dollars of active material once the metal cases and separators are included.
claims.source_title: Cordless Power Tool Battery Technology: Cells, Voltage, and Dual-Battery Systems
claims.supporting_quote: For years, cordless tool packs were built from 18650 cells, the same cylindrical format used in laptops and flashlights. The number describes the size: 18 millimeters across and 65 millimeters long.
